Website Terms

Using the AutixAI website and starting a conversation about automation.

Updated 7 October 2026

Information and examples

This website describes services we can discuss and scope with your business. Workflow demonstrations are simulations. Cards marked “Example Automation” describe possible approaches, not completed client projects or verified results. Calculator outputs use your assumptions and are not guaranteed savings, a valuation or a price quote.

Free audit and enquiries

The initial automation audit is a free conversation and assessment of the process you share, with possible workflows, tools and an implementation approach. It does not include building or deploying an automation. Preparing a form draft does not send a WhatsApp message or reserve a call. We personally confirm any requested meeting. Please provide accurate contact details and use anonymised examples.

Project agreements

Implementation begins only after the work is scoped and agreed. The project agreement defines deliverables, prices, payment arrangements, timelines, third-party costs, ownership, data access, acceptance criteria and support. These website terms do not replace that agreement. Changes and additional work are agreed separately.

Responsible use and your control

Do not use this website to submit malicious content, impersonate others or share information you are not entitled to disclose. A project may need authorised access to your tools. AI outputs can be incorrect; important actions should have appropriate checks and agreed human review. Access, monitoring and responsibilities are discussed during scoping.

External services and website availability

WhatsApp, booking providers and integration platforms operate under their own terms. Their inclusion is not a claim of partnership or endorsement. Features, provider support and access can change. If a website feature is unavailable, you can contact AutixAI by phone or WhatsApp. No uptime or business outcome is promised by the website.

Privacy and contact

Read our Privacy Policy for website information handling. Contact AutixAI on +91 96173 10042 or WhatsApp about these terms. We may update them as the website changes; the date above identifies this version.
